budget_amendment.user_authorization: 総上限時間は8時間に緩和してください
budget_amendment.retention: Append-only ledger amendment retains the original first-reservation epoch, all previous costs, pending and halt conditions. All non-wall limits, model profiles, prompts, tasks, oracle, seeds and trial budgets are unchanged. The completed v1 pilot and original protocol/harness segment are preserved; unused confirmation inputs receive a new v2 freeze.

profile_selection: Largest profile whose conservative six-calls-per-arm forecast fits 90% of remaining global wall budget and remaining call/token caps. Per-model request forecast uses maximum observed client wall minus observed load duration plus observed controller/resource-sampling overhead; model-block load costs are reserved once per model. Missing load/sampling observations retain conservative whole-request wall and explicit unknown fields. Uses speed, memory and remaining budget only, never oracle outcomes. Eight is the smallest confirmation profile; otherwise pilot-only.
primary: Within each model, parent-paired A minus B evidence-supported completion; false acceptance and grounded abstention separately. C is a pooled-information reference with a different information arrival policy.

auxiliary.policy: Predeclared first parent in every family, A and B both models. Immediately after a known no_progress main stop, preserve primary record and continue a copied exact checkpoint by at most two unused callbacks within the original trial wall/token/call budget. No ordinary run replay, budget reset or successful trial rerun. Mixed-role sensitivity only with remaining envelope; otherwise explicitly unexecuted.

resources.sampling: before and after dispatch; process working/private bytes are observations, not a hard whole-server/GPU peak or energy meter

cost_subsets: both A and B evidence-supported complete

post_confirmation_changes: Any runtime, harness, prompt, oracle or task change requires a new protocol and unused confirmation inputs; retain old records and never reset aggregate budgets.
public_gold_separation: Only PublicTask enters factory, prompts, selector and callback. GoldTask is an evaluation-only posthoc input. No model PASS or SDK satisfied flag substitutes for independent witness/provenance/version scoring.
model_evidence_digest: Canonical structured model output JSON only; request IDs, trace metadata and callback counters are retained separately and cannot manufacture new answer content.
release_authorization: The user's explicit request authorizes v0.2.3 publication; the supplied file's no-new-version publication assumption is superseded. Existing tags and public assets are immutable.
